about: Cases the evaluators must pass: 'links', 'redirectSources' and 'pageLinks' are run by both the C# evaluator (Taproot.Domain/SiteChecks) and the TypeScript evaluator (shared/site-checks.ts); 'pageStructure' and 'formKeys' have no C# counterpart and are run by the TypeScript side only. 'links' pin the internal link extractor, 'redirectSources' pin source normalization and the redirect source rules, 'pageLinks' pin the link.page_missing findings for one page. 'pageStructure' pin the page-structure findings (TR00947) the editor and the CLI evaluate from shared/page-structure-checks.ts; a case with 'rendered' is also rendered by the generator, which must publish the headings (and a banner title) the case lists. 'formKeys' pin the form.key_unknown findings (TR01081) the CLI raises against a workspace's form files.

links.name: html anchors and an entity-encoded componentData are read
an encoded query delimiter is cut after decoding
an encoded fragment delimiter is cut after decoding
rich-text link marks resolve relative to the page's folder
external, fragment, query, protocol-relative, mail and asset targets are not pages
the site root, a trailing slash and a query are normalized
targets differing by case are one link, and the first spelling is kept
property names match without regard to case
a componentData string that is not JSON is read as HTML
bare strings in an array are not examined
a relative link that climbs above the root is dropped
named and numeric character references in an address are decoded

pageLinks.name: a link to a page the site has is not reported, case and slashes aside
links to pages the site lacks are reported in order
a named character reference matches the page it spells

pageStructure.name: a title heading with ordered subheadings has nothing to report
a page with content and no h1 is missing its title
a page with nothing on it has no title yet and no warning
an empty level 1 heading claims the title but leaves the page without a usable h1
a second level 1 heading is demoted under the first
a heading that skips a level is renumbered
a heading before the h1 keeps its level and is called out
a banner with overlay text claims the h1 and demotes the author's level 1 heading
a banner without overlay text leaves the title to the author's heading
a banner after the page's first content is not its title
a banner with overlay text and no image claims nothing
a hero title claims the h1 and demotes the author's level 1 heading
a hero title after the h1 is a second h1
headings inside a section are read in document order
a CTA heading fixes level 2, so a level 4 heading after it publishes as level 3
a heading inside a list closes the open title before an overlay banner
a fact list before an overlay banner closes the open title
an adopted fragment before an overlay banner closes the open title (findings only)
an adopted fragment that carries an h1 leaves the page with one (findings only)
component data that is not a JSON string is an empty component
an image without alt text is called out, one with alt text is not
a hero picture or a call to action picture without alt text is called out
a banner image without alt text is called out
a link with no text is called out, a link split by formatting is not
a title longer than search results show is called out
a title at the limit is not
an empty description is called out
a description longer than search results show is called out
a description the surface cannot read is not judged
no cover falls back to the first image
a hero picture or a section's photo background counts as an image for the link preview
no cover and no image leaves link previews without a picture
a selected cover is fine
a page that is not free-form is judged by its metadata only

formKeys.name: a key the workspace has is fine
a key no form file has is called out once, however often it is placed
two unknown keys are listed in the order they were placed
no placed keys, nothing to report
